expenses_billed_when_rechargeable.name: expenses_billed_when_rechargeable
expenses_billed_when_rechargeable.value: "expenses"."rechargeable" or ("expenses"."invoice_id" is null and "expenses"."recovered_on" is null)

project_tasks_dates_order.name: project_tasks_dates_order
project_tasks_dates_order.value: "project_tasks"."due_date" is null or "project_tasks"."start_date" is null or "project_tasks"."due_date" >= "project_tasks"."start_date"

projects_dates_order.name: projects_dates_order
projects_dates_order.value: "projects"."end_date" is null or "projects"."start_date" is null or "projects"."end_date" >= "projects"."start_date"

variations_sent_frozen.name: variations_sent_frozen
variations_sent_frozen.value: "variations"."status" = 'draft' or ("variations"."snapshot" is not null and "variations"."content_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "variations"."sent_at" is not null)

variations_approved_signed.name: variations_approved_signed
variations_approved_signed.value: "variations"."status" <> 'approved' or ("variations"."signature" is not null and "variations"."decision_name" is not null)
